citation: For extraordinary valor in the Capellan theater during [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreOpRAT],Operation RAT]], House Davion awards {CompanyName} the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreDecoration_Davion_FederatedSunsMedalofHonor],Federated Suns Medal of Honor]]. {CompanyName} served with disctincion in the Battles of Tikonov, Menkar, Foochow, New Macau, and Matsu, and their efforts to secure Star League-era technology went above and beyond the normal bounds of service.
